answer: Every agent must escrow a bond before it may attest, and voting weight tracks the age of that bond instead of the number of keys an operator controls. To manufacture influence, a sybil farm has to fund a separate stake for each alias and let every one season through the same waiting period, so the attack pays in locked capital and calendar time at once. An atlas of seasoned stakes replaces a crowd of newborn identities, since manufactured reputation is ivory that cannot be grown overnight, and the cheap bridge of bulk wallet creation buys no voice at all.
